articles.title: Firelight raises $8 million, expands beyond XRP as it aims to make DeFi less scary for fintechs
articles.snippet: The protocol aims to give fintechs and investors a faster way to recover losses from DeFi hacks, while letting XRP, bitcoin and XLM holders earn yield by backing that protection.

articles.title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
articles.snippet: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.

articles.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
articles.snippet: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

articles.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
articles.snippet: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

articles.title: Bitmine makes largest ether purchase since June as Tom Lee points to crypto's strong Q3
articles.snippet: Company Chairman Lee said crypto’s recent outperformance could draw more institutional investors.
